title: Sync Safety and Document Status
notes: Tracks the last synced cloud revision and local modification status per document.
Blocks uploads when a newer cloud revision and unsynced local changes would conflict.
Creates a local recovery snapshot before every cloud download and supports Undo Cloud Download.
Shows clear LOCAL and CLOUD status in Cloud Sync.
Adds Smart Sync while retaining manual upload, download, refresh, and delete controls.
Preserves legacy Firebase records and all m40.0.4 timing, backup, conversion, PDF, and document behavior.
